story.heading: Why the reviews say the same thing
paragraphs: Philadelphia Garage has built its reputation on two decisions repeated for more than 20 years: hire the best installers and use quality materials. The result is a garage floor that still looks beautiful after the winter salt and the summer tires.

The concierge level of service is the other half. One team walks the space with you, finds the personalized solution that fits how you actually use the garage, and installs it without turning your week upside down.

experience.heading: How a makeover runs
items: A visit to the garage in West Chester or anywhere in the Philadelphia area, with real measurements and real samples.
A plan for the floor and the storage together, so the coating and the cabinets are designed for each other.
Installation by the same experienced crew, then a walk-through before anyone leaves.

feature.heading: Beautiful, durable garage floors
feature.text: High-grade coatings resist hot tires, road salt, and dropped tools, and they wipe clean. The finish is chosen with you, from flake blends to solid color.

story.heading: A salon that fits into the trip
paragraphs: Pro-Nails Nailery has been part of the Willow Grove Park Mall for years, the salon people find between the department stores and the food court and then come back to on purpose.
The pitch is simple: professional work, a menu that covers hands and feet and waxing, and hours that match the mall so a manicure fits around the rest of the day.

experience.heading: How a visit goes
items: Walk in from the mall concourse or call ahead to hold a chair at a busy hour.
Pick the service, pick the color, and settle in; pedicure chairs take the long soak seriously.
Pay by card and walk back out to the rest of the shopping trip.

feature.heading: Pedicures with the soak built in
feature.text: The pedicure is the salon's signature: a proper soak, careful cuticle work, and polish that is dry before you reach the parking garage.

gallery.heading: Fire, stone, and <mark>the rooms around them.</mark>

story.heading: Fifty years of Pennsylvania winters
paragraphs: Salter's opened in 1974 and never left Montgomery County. The Eagleville showroom on Ridge Pike is where most first visits start, and the Hatfield showroom fills the original 1924 Hatfield Firehouse in the heart of town.

Both floors exist so a family can stand in front of a burning unit before buying it. Outdoor living grew out of the same idea: see the grill, the fire pit, and the furniture together, then build the backyard around them.

experience.heading: How a project runs
items: Visit either showroom Tuesday through Saturday and see the units lit, not just pictured.
Salter's measures the room or the patio and quotes the install with the product.
Service and repair stay in-house, so the people who installed it are the people who come back.

feature.heading: The Hatfield Firehouse showroom
feature.text: Eight thousand six hundred square feet inside the 1924 firehouse at 56 E Broad Street, filled with fireplaces, stoves, grills, patio furniture, fire pits, and outdoor kitchens.

spotlight.heading: Outdoor kitchens and fire pits
spotlight.text: The outdoor living side is a full department, from built-in grills to the seating that surrounds a fire pit, designed to last through Southeastern PA seasons.

story.heading: A family business in two counties
paragraphs: Southampton Hot Tub started as a family operation and still runs like one, with a showroom in Exton on Pottstown Pike and a second in Huntingdon Valley on County Line Road.

The brands on the floor are the ones the family would put in its own backyard. Jacuzzi, Bullfrog, Sundance, and Artesian hot tubs, swim spas, LeisureCraft and Sun & Soul saunas, and Kodiak cold plunges.

experience.heading: Buying and owning
items: Wet-test and compare models in a showroom instead of guessing from a catalog.
Delivery and placement handled by the same team, including relocations when you move.
Seasonal service from certified technicians: winterization in the fall, restarts in spring, repairs in between.

feature.heading: Saunas and cold plunges
